info.name: Mock Purchase Order Backends (ERP, SRM, TMS)
info.description:
Every operation of the three mock backends behind the Supplier Order Collaboration API.

* Pick the **Local** or **Tunnel** environment (or edit `baseUrl`).
* Run a whole folder or the collection in order: create requests save IDs (`poNumber`, `supplierCode`, `shipmentId`, ...) into collection variables for later requests, and each backend folder cleans up after itself.
* Every request has tests; most have a saved example response.
* API keys: `erpApiKey`, `srmApiKey`, `tmsApiKey` (set on each folder as an `x-api-key` header).

Newman: `npx newman run postman/mock-po-backends.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json`
